# Gutter-It LLC

> Family-owned gutter and pressure washing company serving Chattanooga, TN and the surrounding Hamilton County area. We do gutter cleaning, seamless gutter installation, gutter repair, gutter guards, and pressure washing. Honest, on-site pricing with no surprise add-ons. Licensed, insured, and locally owned.

## Business details

- Name: Gutter-It LLC
- Owner: Jakob Demoss
- Phone: (423) 475-3158

- Service area: Chattanooga, Hixson, East Brainerd, Ooltewah, Signal Mountain, Lookout Mountain, Soddy-Daisy, Red Bank, East Ridge, and Collegedale (all in TN)
- Website: https://www.gutteritllc.com

## Services & typical pricing

- **Gutter Cleaning** — from $100. Single-story homes typically $100–$175; two-story $150–$250. Most homes need it twice a year; homes with pines may need a third visit.
- **Gutter Repair** — from $50. Sagging sections, leaky seams, separated downspouts, re-pitching. Most repairs run $50–$200.
- **Seamless Gutter Installation** — aluminum seamless gutters formed on-site, roughly $5.40–$9.40 per linear foot installed (a typical 150-ft home is ~$800–$1,400).
- **Gutter Guards** — leaf/gutter guard and leaf guard installation to reduce cleaning frequency. Installed only when they actually make sense for your trees and budget.
- **Pressure Washing** — house washing, soft washing, roof cleaning, driveway/concrete cleaning, deck and fence cleaning.

Related work: downspout cleaning, unclogging, repair and installation; gutter flushing; roof debris removal; gutter inspection and resealing; gutter realignment and re-pitching; leak, fascia, and soffit repair; rain chain installation; rainwater diversion; splash block installation; underground downspout drainage.
